description: Result notice with configurable action, dismissal and duration.

howToUse: Use it for the result of an action that does not need a decision: "Invoice sent", "Copied".
Put ToastRegion once in the app and keep the list of toasts in your state; remove them in `onDismiss`.
Add an action when it helps, such as "Undo". The toast stays while the pointer or the focus is on it.
alternatives: An error in a field: the `error` of the field.
A message that must stay on the page: Callout.

keyboard.action: Moves to the action and to the close button of the toast.
Runs the action or closes the toast.

props.name: duration
props.description: ms until auto-dismiss. `null` = stays until closed. Default 5000.

props.name: toasts
props.description: Toast stack (controlled: the app owns the list).

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Removes a toast from the list (auto-dismiss, ×, or after the action).
